Chapter 3 - Directory Numbers / Directory Number Reference
Directory Number Functions

Finding Directory Numbers

The Telephone Manager provides functions that you can use to find the directory number or numbers associated with a telephone terminal. You can use the TELCountDNs function to determine how many directory numbers are associated with a particular terminal. You can use the TELDNLookupByIndex and TELDNLookupByName functions to look up a directory number by index and name, respectively.
